pattern: The (.+) feature with an OID = (\d+) has a SEGLOCSTATUS value that is different than what was found using the LION ETL rules\.  Feature = '.*', ETL Rules = '.*' Start #= .*()

note: CenterlineExtractFile.ValidateSegLocStatus: the feature's SEGLOCSTATUS vs the one the LION rules derive

pattern: The (proto segment) record an OID = (\d+) has a SEGLOCSTATUS value that is different than what was found using the LION ETL rules\.  Proto Segment Row = '.*', ETL Rules = '.*'\.()
example: The proto segment record an OID = 123 has a SEGLOCSTATUS value that is different than what was found using the LION ETL rules.  Proto Segment Row = 'X', ETL Rules = ''.
note: CenterlineExtractFile.ValidateSegLocStatus, proto segments

pattern: Neither of the AtomicPolygon borough matches the segment borough for the (.+) feature with an OID = (\d+)\..*()
example: Neither of the AtomicPolygon borough matches the segment borough for the Shoreline feature with an OID = 55. BoroCode = '1', Left = '2' and Right = '2'.
our_error_category: neither joined atomic polygon matches segment's borocode
note: Centerline and Shoreline extracts

pattern: Both offset points for the (.+) feature with an OID = (\d+) failed to find AtomicPolygons\.()
example: Both offset points for the Rail feature with an OID = 6118 failed to find AtomicPolygons.
our_error_category: segment joined to no atomic polygon
note: Prod logs it once per offset-point lookup, so one feature can repeat (26c: Rail 6118 four times)

pattern: Both offset points for the (.+) feature with an OID = (\d+) failed to find NYPDBeats\.()
example: Both offset points for the Centerline feature with an OID = 7 failed to find NYPDBeats.
our_error_category: segment joined to no nypd beat

pattern: Unable to obtain a FaceCode value for the (.+?)(?: feature)? (?:with )?an OID = (\d+)\..*()
example: Unable to obtain a FaceCode value for the Centerline feature an OID = 8.  The feature record will not be included in the LION extract file.
note: LIONExtractorClass: the record is left out of LION

pattern: The borough for the (.+?)(?: feature)? with an OID = (\d+) \(Borough = .*\) does not match the borough currently being extracted \(Borough = .*\)\.()

note: LIONExtractorClass: the record is left out of that borough's LION file

pattern: \[LGC DATA ERROR\] More than 9 LGC values were found for the (.+) feature with an OID = (\d+)\..*()
example: [LGC DATA ERROR] More than 9 LGC values were found for the Centerline feature with an OID = 10.  11 values were found for the record.
our_error_category: more than 9 lgcs for a given segmentid

pattern: \[INVALID ANGLE & RADIUS FOUND\] An invalid angle & radius value was found while calculating the segment curvature for the (.+) feature with an OID = (\d+)\.(?s:.*)()
example: [INVALID ANGLE & RADIUS FOUND] An invalid angle & radius value was found while calculating the segment curvature for the Centerline feature with an OID = 11.  Angle = 0.1, Radius = 99999999, Calculated X = 123456789, Calculated Y = 1.  Using the segment midpoint for the curvature values.
note: Prod: center coordinates longer than 7 digits; ours: center outside 0-9999999

pattern: \[NO CENTER POINT FOUND\] Unable to locate a valid center point while calculating the segment curvature for the (.+) feature with an OID = (\d+)\.(?s:.*)()
example: [NO CENTER POINT FOUND] Unable to locate a valid center point while calculating the segment curvature for the Centerline feature with an OID = 12.  Using the segment midpoint for the curvature values.
note: Not logged by us: prod falls back to the segment midpoint when an arc has no center; we have no equivalent case
